findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: The facility has recently obtained a dish machine and is observed to not have an irreversible registering thermometer to check the heat sanitizing temperature of the machine. CORRECTED- The PIC ordered one during the inspection and it should be at the facility within a couple of days. A spot check will be conducted on 8/19/2025 to ensure that it arrived to the facility. Ensure that there is always a thermometer available to measure the temperature of the dish machine.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.13(B) Temperature Measuring Devices, Manual and Mechanical Warewashing. (B) In hot water mechanical WAREWASHING operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the UTENSIL surface temperature.

findings.title: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use
findings.comment:
2-401.11: Inspector observed employee beverage cups in two areas of the kitchen near clean items or food related items. Provide and use designated space for beverage cups. 

(A) EMPLOYEE SHALL eat, drink, or use tobacco in designated areas away from FOOD and FOOD-RELATED areas. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEE may drink from closed BEVERAGE Container if handled to prevent: (1) hands (2) container (3) FOOD and FOOD-RELATED ITEMS.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-201.11: Inspector observed a bottle of chemical cleaner on the bottom shelf next to stored food equipment. The bottle was removed to floor away from food and food related areas. The violation is considered corrected on site. 

(A)-(B) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be stored to prevent contamination of FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES by separating or locating MATERIALS in area away or below FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES (use partition or store below).

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-305.11: Inspector observed a box of stock containers on the floor along with a bag of sugar. Facility is in the middle of prep and has moved items around. Please put items directly back onto shelves to ensure that they are properly stored. Items were placed on the shelves. Violation is considered corrected on site. 

(A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Inspector observed a red sanitizer bucket upside down in the front hand sink upon arrival. The bucket was removed and the hand sink was used for hand washing. Take care to never block the hand sink. The hand sink must be available at all times. The violation is considered corrected on site.

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

Observed the bathroom handsinks in need of caulking and mop utility sink. Coving is needed at mop sink between the floor and wall. Repair by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

Observed the bathroom doors and exterior back door to not be self-closing. Ensure changes made to prohibit pests (by next routine inspection).
